sources.name: BeenVerified
sources.notes: Separate opt-outs for people search and property search (https://www.beenverified.com/app/optout/address-search). One opt-out per email address; confirm by email link.

sources.name: CheckPeople
sources.notes: Check first with a Right to Know request at https://checkpeople.com/privacy-rights. The opt-out asks for full legal name and birth date.

sources.name: Clustal
sources.notes: Use the URL from 'view full record', not the search result URL. One email address per listing.

sources.name: Intelius
sources.notes: One suppression covers the PeopleConnect family of sites. May ask to confirm address, phone or past emails; send only what the site already shows.

sources.name: Men Stopping Violence (people pages)
sources.notes: Find the listing URL, paste it in the opt-out page, then confirm by email link.

sources.name: MyLife
sources.notes: Email the request with name and profile link. The site may push for an account or ID; do not send ID by default.

sources.name: SmartBackgroundChecks
sources.notes: Removal here likely also removes the PeopleFinders listing.

sources.name: Spokeo
sources.notes: Enter the profile URL and an email in the 'opt out your information' section, then confirm by email link. Paid views may keep data after removal.

sources.name: That's Them
sources.notes: Ignore the paid identity-protection offer on the page.

sources.name: Whitepages
sources.notes: An automated call gives a code to enter. Premium listings may stay; check 411.com too.

sources.name: Acxiom
sources.notes: Marketing data broker; listings are not searchable for free, so removal cannot be re-checked.

sources.name: Ancestry
sources.notes: Needs a free account (not a trial) to find record URLs; email the URLs or use the removal form.

sources.name: FamilyTreeNow
sources.notes: Search, then remove the record from the opt-out page.

sources.name: FastPeopleSearch
sources.notes: Usually shows a CAPTCHA; becomes a Needs-you task.

sources.name: USPhoneBook
sources.notes: If the opt-out page hangs, email the support address.
